{{Quote|A fascinating apex predator with distinctive dorsal&mdash;er, those large, bluish, carnivorous animals.|[[Dagus Parral]]|<ref name="All Animals">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|All Animals Deserve a Chance|[[Voss]]}}</ref>}}
'''Vorantikus''' was a group of large bipedal [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] predator species, native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. The creatures resembled [[Geo Beast|Geo Beasts]], not typically found on Voss.

==Biology and appearance==
Vorantiki walked on two legs, using their long arms to attack their prey. Arms had two clawed digits, while legs had three, with one of them facing backwards. Eyes of vorantiki were glowing in yellow or orange. The most distinctive trait of the species were boney spikes forming four rows across the the creatures' backs and the back side of their arms. The spikes were rounded at the end and not sharp, with an exception of an additional shorter spike that was coming out of vorantikis' chin.<ref name="cartel" />

Vorantiki had two known sexes with no visible sexual dimorphism. Both matriarchs and patriarchs of vorantiki were hunting in the Voss wilds,<ref name="Patriarch" /><ref name="Matriarch" /> and the species was atop the Voss food chain. Creatures were lone hunters, stalking prey in an endless search for the next meal. Among the known predators of Voss and its nearby systems, vorantiki were considered both the largest and the deadliest.<ref name="codex" />

===Subspecies===
The most common blue-colored variation of vorantikus was known as '''Savanna Vorantikus'''. Other included '''Marshwood Vorantikus''' and '''Cave Vorantikus''', both with unique patterns of skin color, and a dark bone pigmentation. Unlike the Savanna vorantiki, these two subspecies had eye-pupils. All three vorantiki subspecies could potentially be trainable to be used as mounts.<ref name="cartel" />  

==History==
Vorantiki held a significant role in [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] culture. The Gormak revered vorantiki for their power and fearlessness, often depicting the creatures inside their domiciles. The subjects of crudely scrawled pictures typically included a vorantikus devouring a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]], or laying waste to the city of [[Voss-Ka]] itself, though no historical account of any such attack upon the Voss capital existed.<ref name="codex" /> Around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] experimented on vorantiki to create monstrous [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Cyberbeast|war beasts]].<ref name="needs better referencing">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

The [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Sel-Makor]] corrupted a vorantikus into the servant known as the [[Gormak Guardian]].<ref name="needs better referencing" />
